metadata.caption: Implications between assumptions, lemmas and theorems. Positivity and dynamic consistency are assumed to hold in all implications.

nodes.name: \normalfont\scshape Assumption 2: Memoryless Ass
nodes.statement:
In the causal ADMG, $(\overline{S}_{t-1} \cup \overline{A}_{t-1}) \setminus
  S_t$ and $N_{t+1}$ are m-separated by $S_t$ for all $t \in [T]$.

nodes.name: \normalfont\scshape Assumption 1: Nested states Ass
nodes.statement: We assume $S_t \subseteq S_{t-1} \cup A_{t-1} \cup X_t$  for all $t \in [T]$.

nodes.name: \normalfont\scshape Assumption 3: Dyn back-door Ass
nodes.statement:
In the causal ADMG, every path from $A_k$ to $N_{t+1}$ with an
  arrowhead into $A_k$ is ancestrally blocked by $S_k$ for all $k \leq
  t \leq T$.

nodes.name: assump:no-confounding-b: Dyn unconf Ass
\normalfont\scshape  Lemma 3.3
nodes.statement:
Assume that $R_t \subseteq S_t$ for $t \in [T]$. Under Assumptions 1 and 2, we have
    \begin{align*}
        (\underline{N}_{t+1} \cup
      \underline{A}_{t+1})(\underline{g}_t) \perp \!\!\! \perp (A_{t-1} \cup
      S_{t-1}) \setminus S_t \mid (A_t \cup
      S_t)(\underline{g}_t),~\text{for all}~t \in [T].
    \end{align*}

nodes.name: \normalfont\scshape  Lemma 3.2
nodes.statement:
Assume that $R_t \subseteq S_t$ for $t \in [T]$. Under 1 and assump:no-confounding-b, we have
    \begin{align*}
        (\underline{N}_{t+1} \cup
      \underline{A}_{t+1})(\underline{g}_t) \perp \!\!\! \perp
      A^{-}_t(\underline{g}_t) \mid (A_t \cup S_t)(\underline{g}_t),~t
      \in [T].
    \end{align*}

nodes.name: \normalfont\scshape Theorem 3.4
\normalfont\scshape Theorem 1.1
nodes.statement:
Let dynamic consistency and positivity be given, and suppose $R_t
    \subseteq S_t$ for $t \in [T]$. Under Assumptions 1,
    2, and 3,
    we have
                                
                                
                                
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    \begin{align*}
      \mathbb{P}(\overline{N}_{T+1}(g) =
      \overline{n}_{T+1}, \overline{A}_{T}(g) =
      \overline{a}_{T}) = \mathbb{P}(r_{T+1} \mid a_T, s_T)
      \prod_{t=1}^T g(a_{t} \mid s_{t}) \mathbb{P}(n_{t} \mid a_{t-1},
      s_{t-1}).
    \end{align*}
